Content: A genetically modified pig, nicknamed the “enviropig,” has the ability to produce a bacterial enzyme in its saliva that helps reduce the amount of phosphorus in its wastes. Phosphorus pollution is a serious environmental concern. Enviropigs are expensive, but the cost is balanced against the benefit to the environment. There is also a concern that the US Department of Agriculture still has not cleared enviropig meat for human consumption.
